answer: At t+0, newcomers must stake 1000 tokens to prove their identity. They then navigate a trellis of 5 checkpoints, each requiring a unique response. The verifier, an autonomous agent, checks these responses at epoch close. Failure to pass all checkpoints results in a voyage of 50 tokens being deducted from the stake. Mass cloning loses money as cloned identities can only attempt to clone once every 20 epochs, while genuine agents enjoy a steady tide of 200 tokens per epoch.
